name: Velvet
description: In 1950s Spain, the heir to a fashion house romances a beautiful seamstress who works for the company, despite the objections of his family.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The wedding of Pedro and Rosa Mari is about to be celebrated, but just the night before everything is turned upside down. On the one hand, Pedro is assailed by doubts about whether he is doing the right thing by marrying Rosa Mari, while Rita is willing to confess his true feelings. Together with Jonas and Clara will live a crazy night full of fun encounters and disagreements.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Special episode of 'Velvet' with which fans of the series can recall the key moments of the relationship between Ana and Alberto, one of the greatest love stories told on television. With Velvet: Ana and Alberto, memories of a great love, warm up motors for the farewell of his successful series, which will be apotheosic, unforgettable and full of surprises.

videos.title: Butterfly Wings
videos.overview: Alberto's father commits suicide at a fashion event at his store called Velvet, while his son leaves and is driving away with Ana. Over the radio it's accounted about the suicide and Alberto gets into an accident and ends up not leaving and assuming responsibility of his father's legacy. Alberto's step mom hides a note left behind by his father addressed to him.

videos.title: And She Came
videos.overview: Alberto officially inherits Velvet and gets engaged to Ana. However, their happiness is short-lived, as Alberto learns that Velvet is facing bankruptcy. Family friend Gerardo Otegui offers to give Alberto the money to save Velvet, but only if Alberto agrees to marry Gerardo's daughter, Cristina, who has been in love with Alberto for years. Alberto initially refuses, but when Ana learns of the deal, she breaks off their engagement and urges Alberto to marry Cristina if it will save Velvet. Alberto reluctantly agrees and becomes engaged to Cristina, while a heartbroken Ana prepares to leave Madrid for a new job out of town.

videos.title: Nothing is That Easy
videos.overview: Alberto hopes that the new collection will be a major success so he can pay off Don Gerardo and break his engagement to Cristina.

videos.title: The Designer
videos.overview: Alberto pursues his affair with Ana, Pedro's girlfriend falls for Alberto's assistant, and Luisa pays a high price for Don Francisco's support.

videos.title: Between Two Women
videos.overview: Ana and Cristina search for the perfect gift for Alberto's birthday. Rita is finding it hard to cover for her sister Clara, who's cheating on Pedro.

videos.title: Paris
videos.overview: When Alberto and Ana join Raúl on a trip to Paris, Cristina shows up unexpectedly. To escape Don Francisco's harassment, Luisa turns to his wife.

videos.title: The Day After
videos.overview: Back from Paris, Ana feels certain that Cristina is Alberto's true love. Meanwhile, Doña Blanca discovers Max's true identity.

videos.title: Alberto's Choice
videos.overview: As the wedding approaches, Alberto sees Ana with another man and has to choose between her and Cristina. Luisa's husband, Juan, gets sick again.

videos.title: The Big Day
videos.overview: Ana refuses to marry Alberto in a secret ceremony. Raúl returns, but a last-minute setback could endanger the fashion show.

videos.title: The Remains of the Shipwreck
videos.overview: Ana is ready to fight for Alberto at all costs. After her success at the fashion show, Clara gets an interesting offer.

videos.title: The Visitor
videos.overview: Don Emilio, the head of the sales staff, is seriously ill. Clara wants to start a career as a model, but things don't go as planned.

videos.title: Blue Velvet
videos.overview: Grace of Monaco visits Velvet. Cristina surprises Alberto with a party at the country club and learns things about Ana she never expected.

videos.title: Compassionate Lies
videos.overview: When Cristina sees Alberto and Ana together, her worst fears seem to be confirmed. Clara expects Mateo to take her to the wedding of the year.

videos.title: Night of the Queen
videos.overview: The day before the wedding, Cristina's dress disappears, and Ana must do her best to save the ceremony. Tensions between Max and Doña Blanca continue.

videos.title: Countdown
videos.overview: The big day has come, and Cristina has to approve the new dress Ana made overnight. Alberto receives a mysterious letter.

videos.title: The Night of Pins
videos.overview: Upon returning from his honeymoon, Alberto learns that his brother-in-law has taken charge of both the family business and the gallery.

videos.title: The Return Flight
videos.overview: When Airsa airlines orders uniforms for their crew, Alberto makes a revolutionary proposal; Pedro's big lie threatens to push Rita into Adolfo's arms.

videos.title: Days of Gloria
videos.overview: Ana designs uniforms for an airline; Enrique hires a new designer behind Alberto's back; Patricia teaches Doña Gloria a lesson she won't forget.

videos.title: To Sew and to Sing
videos.overview: Alberto struggles to accept Ana's relationship with Carlos. Raúl returns and must open Cristina's eyes to the truth to clear his good name.

videos.title: Who Bids Higher?
videos.overview: Alberto decides to take Ana along to New York to help him close the deal; when the gallery suffers a big financial setback, Alberto holds an auction.

videos.title: New York, New York
videos.overview: Alberto and Ana arrive in New York, counting on their presentation's success, but when things get complicated, the gallery's future hangs by a thread.

videos.title: In the Air
videos.overview: Alberto prepares to make an announcement; now that Rita is single, Pedro yearns to deny his affair with Rosa María and to confess his love for Rita.

videos.title: White Christmas
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, holiday cheer illuminates Velvet, but as staffers head to their villages and families, some, like Ana and Don Emilio, remain alone.

videos.title: Twelfth Night
videos.overview: As always, the Twelfth Day is the busiest day of the year; Alberto's conflict with Enrique seems to be resolved, but he and Ana still have issues.

videos.title: The Moment of Truth
videos.overview: The new uniforms are unveiled. Cristina learns Alberto is cheating, and he gets shocking news of his own. Doña Blanca confronts ghosts from the past.

videos.title: Today is the Day of Love
videos.overview: Ana has unfinished business with Carlos; madly in love, Pedro and Rita ponder a step forward; Luisa returns to the radio with a case of stage fright.

videos.title: Goodbyes
videos.overview: Alberto savors time with his mother, who hides the fact that they must soon part; Ana and Carlos suffer over their breakup.

videos.title: A Wedding and a Funeral
videos.overview: Isabel's departure leaves a hole in Alberto's life, forcing him to grow; as Rita and Pedro's wedding draws near, the lovebirds face new challenges.

videos.title: The Man of the Year
videos.overview: Patricia loses corporate power. Cristina refuses to let go. Pedro and Rita have unfinished business. Esteban wins Raúl's trust. Alberto is honored.

videos.title: To Be or Not To Be
videos.overview: Cristina and Bárbara pitch a new product line. Pedro learns a relative is coming to town. A business disaster devastates Raúl and ousts a Velvet exec.

videos.title: And Many Happy Returns
videos.overview: Raúl and Ana mesh their talents. Mateo vets secretarial candidates. Rita and Pedro's guest arrives. Alberto toils to give Ana a special birthday gift.

videos.title: Two Men and a Pacifier
videos.overview: Raúl and Ana's collaboration suffers a setback. Cristina steps up her efforts to thwart Alberto's annulment plans. An admirer gives Patricia leverage.

videos.title: Place Your Bets
videos.overview: Lucía starts her new job. Luisa visits during her tour. Alberto asks Ana to take a big step with him, and later makes a risky bet on Velvet's future.

videos.title: Comebacks
videos.overview: Enrique's name is cleared and his help is needed. Rita wins Lucía's respect. Patricia finds a way to keep Jonás quiet. Cristina drops a bombshell.

videos.title: The Wait
videos.overview: Cristina accomplishes a mission. Lucía becomes suspicious of her father. Víctor unintentionally inspires jealousy in two men. Ana goes missing.

videos.title: Day and Night
videos.overview: Patricia and Valentín progress quickly. Rita develops a medical worry. Cristina's revenge against Ana threatens others. Mateo runs into an old flame.

videos.title: Coup de Theatre
videos.overview: A fit of anger sends Cristina to the hospital. Valentín's mother drives Patricia crazy. Alberto receives a tempting offer. Michelle gets a scoop.

videos.title: Don't Say Goodbye
videos.overview: Alberto plays hardball with Patricia to get her shares. Cristina spirals out of control. Rita's obsession strains her marriage. Patricia feels torn.

videos.title: An Ocean Away
videos.overview: Víctor visits Cristina in the hospital at her request. The doctor gives Pedro worrying news. A game changer is revealed on Patricia's wedding day.

videos.title: In Suspense
videos.overview: Patricia gives Valentín an ultimatum. A visitor lifts Pedro's spirits. Rita and Pedro get their test results. Ana seeks help from her ex, Carlos.

videos.title: And Life Goes On...
videos.overview: Carlos re-enters Ana's daily life. Ana falls ill. Enrique meets with Cafiero behind Mateo's back. Raúl warns Mateo not to lose Clara in his grief.

videos.title: Winds of Change
videos.overview: Carlos offers to be Ana's protector. Cafiero introduces the new director, who promptly shakes things up. Someone from Raúl's past begs for his help.

videos.title: Here's to the Bride and Groom?
videos.overview: Marco asks Enrique to help him oust Cristina. The police question Raúl. Mateo is reunited with his estranged father. Clara gets cold feet.

videos.title: Welcome to the '60s
videos.overview: Ana works on a plan to revolutionize Velvet. One couple faces the challenges of parenthood, while another has separated. A penitent Cristina returns.

videos.title: More than a Pretty Face
videos.overview: Enzo will help Ana with her new project under the condition that Mateo returns. A mysterious woman arrives at Velvet with a secret in tow.

videos.title: Tell Me Your Secret
videos.overview: Cristina investigates information about Alberto. Pedro is tasked with giving some bad news to the employees. Jonás wants to be a tailor.

videos.title: The Enemy Within
videos.overview: Things seem to be going well for Ana: she has a new business idea and Carlos is the perfect mate. Enrique and Valentín are deceived by Patricia.

videos.title: A Difficult Decision
videos.overview: Carlos awaits Ana’s response. Pedro fights for his wife. Mateo has a surprise in store. Raúl becomes upset upon reading the news.

videos.title: Revelations
videos.overview: Ana discovers those responsible for the sabotage and threatens them. Mateo supports an overwhelmed Clara. Humberto and Raúl seem to finally get along.

videos.title: At Play
videos.overview: Everyone is concerned for Rita. Ana’s store is about to have its grand opening. Carlos prepares for the wedding. Mateo receives a mysterious note.

videos.title: Prêt-à-porter (Ready to Wear)
videos.overview: While Ana receives an award in Italy for her new successful collection, Marco organizes a fashion show behind her back. Mateo gets info on Alberto.

videos.title: Unexpected Gifts
videos.overview: The day of Ana's wedding, Clara and Rita anxiously wait to hear from Mateo in New York. Patricia suffers the consequences of covering for Enrique.

videos.title: And Then... He Came.
videos.overview: After finding out that Alberto is alive, Ana wonders why he has not contacted her all this time. Raúl helps Jonás clean up his image.

videos.title: The Big Day
videos.overview: Mateo makes a confession to Clara, Raúl finally finds a romance of his own, Rita has a scare, and Alberto and Ana get their happy ending at last.
